findings.text: follow-on: _stop_locked returns early when state is None or state.pid is None, so the recorded-pid fallback at 770-771 is unreachable and a running service absent from self._states is no longer stopped by its recorded pid where the base revision stopped it; reach is narrow because reload only stops names it tracks, but the fallback is now dead code.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit -- 9b28ccd adds the lease primitive, 1fe1b9b wires the arbitration into DeclaredServices, bc9404d adds the tests; four files changed, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_host_lease.py and tests/test_fleet_supervisor_runs_declared_services.py; the manifest records that run (29 passed, EXIT=0) and the two-arm evidence it names, and the tests cover all three bullets -- one copy with the second host reporting the holder, a stale lease taken over and a fresh one not, and a temporary services config starting no real service.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to hold each declared fleet service to one copy across nodes via a shared-storage lease reusable by a later producer seat; reckon/crew/host_lease.py:26 HostLease names host, pid and job on the fleet state directory and reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:665-704 gates every declared-service start on it, so the landed change does what the goal states.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command and its result, names final-gate.log and both arm logs, and records the baseline_suite and after_suite observations plus a declared negative control.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/host_lease.py, reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py, tests/test_host_lease.py and tests/test_fleet_supervisor_runs_declared_services.py; the diff touches exactly those four files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_fleet_supervisor_runs_declared_services.py:240 fails with two PIDs at the base revision (baseline-arm.log), so the one-copy test reddens if the lease is removed.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records final-gate.log (29 passed, EXIT=0) and the two arm logs; baseline-arm.log shows the one-copy test failing at 9eecf97 with two PIDs, so the evidence could have failed.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/host_lease.py:26 follows the surrounding crew-module idiom (frozen dataclass, atomic link, module docstring) and introduces no plan label, version or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:665-704 gates each declared-service start on lease.claim() and reckon/crew/host_lease.py:26 supplies the shared-storage lease the goal names.
justifications.reuse: no owner exists for a renewable single-owner claim with time-based staleness; searching reckon/ found reckon/crew/dispatch.py:_claim_node_dispatch (exclusive-create claim, process-liveness staleness) and reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:producer_lease_is_live (renewed interval stamp), which HostLease neither extends nor duplicates.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only the four declared write paths; fleet_supervisor.py:96-99 also drops a zellij ticket/version reference, inside an allowed file and aligned with the naming rule.
